environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Quarkus 3.2 runtime, exposed via Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://<url-id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway, no WAF, no VPC restrictions. The Lambda execution role has broad permissions. Commons-collections 3.2.1 is on the classpath via a transitive dependency from a legacy workflow library.
